'''Anoth''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The world was shattered at some point during an unknown cataclysm, but remained largely together due to its gravitational pull.

==Geography==
A remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the world was made up of three massive pieces that were formerly wound into one large mass. Orbiting a common center of mass, two of the fragments were close enough to share a deadly atmosphere rendering it completely inhospitable; when they occasionally scraped together, a static discharge was generated, creating a sensor-masking electrical current that roiled across the surface. The other fragment, father away from the other pieces, had maintained a life-supporting atmosphere and was considered to hold the third orbital position in the system. Orbiting a white dwarf, the world's sky was violet throughout the entire day and night, casting a mysterious glow across the landscape.<ref name="COTF" />

==History==
Discovered following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Anoth was a shattered world, broken into three large chunks during an unknown cataclysm in its past. Having once hosted a [[Human/Legends|Human]] population, the world had a breathable atmosphere, though it was heavily polluted by modern times and its populace non-existent.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Anoth (Clone Wars)|fought]] the Republic on the planet's habitable portion and defeated the galactic government.<ref name="WildSpace">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref> Falling out of memory and records, Anoth was not located on any [[Star map/Legends|star-charts]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Rediscovered in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], they established a [[Anoth Base|fortress]] fit to protect the youngest child of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]], [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]]. Stationed there with his protector, [[Winter Celchu|Winter]], the fortress was eventually discovered by the persistent and sinister [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Furgan]] who attempted to capture the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] boy. Using [[Mountain Terrain Armored Transport|MT-ATs]] to scale the mountainous geography near the fortress, Furgan [[Battle of Anoth (Galactic Civil War)|infiltrated]] the bastion and kidnapped the boy. Furgan did not make it out of the complex before Solo was rescued. The Ambassador would die in his attempted escape from the fortress.<ref name="COTF" />

For several years, the fortress was left abandoned, under close scrutiny by the Republic, which monitored any news on Anoth's location. Once assured that it remained unknown to the great galactic population, the fortress was refurbished as a private retreat for the Solo's, who used it during the [[Almanian Uprising]], as a safe house for their children once more.<ref name="NewRebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>

==Behind the Scenes==
In the cancelled novel written by [[Tom Veitch]], [[Lightsider (story)|''Lightsider'']], Anoth was the planet chosen by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ranik Solusar]] to hide [[Solusar family|his family]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. There, Ranik's son [[Kam Solusar]] trained his children, [[Jaxor Solusar|Jaxor]] and [[Tev Solusar|Tev]], in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|The Force]]. However, thirty-five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[Operation Shadow Hand]], the Solusar family's refuge on Anoth was discovered by the Empire, and all but Kam were killed by the subsequent attack. Along with his droid [[EV-9T9]], Kam fled Anoth and departed [[The galaxy/Legends|the known galaxy]].<ref name="Lightsider">[[Lightsider (story)|''Lightsider'']]</ref>

In [[2023]], two unreleased manuscripts of ''Lightsider'' from 1996 and 2009 were obtained by author [[Joseph Bongiorno]] and uploaded onto the website starwarstimeline.net,<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarstimeline.net/latest_news.htm|text=Lightsider Online Release|work=StarWarsTimeline Expanded Universe News|quote="In case you missed it, here is the PDF for the Tom Veitch story, Lightsider, a lost EU work that takes place between Dark Empire I and II. Click on the title here or on the right column to download Tom Veitch's unpublished, previously lost bridge story between Dark Empires I and II" - Joseph Bongiorno.|archivedate=20231209175121}}</ref> revealing the intended role Anoth would have played in the novel had it released.
